title: Catastrophic bifurcation in the dynamics of a threatened bird community triggered by a planetary-scale environmental perturbation.
reference: Pablo Almaraz, Andy J. Green (2024) Catastrophic bifurcation in the dynamics of a threatened bird community triggered by a planetary-scale environmental perturbation. Biological Conservation 291: 110466, DOI: 10.1016/j.biocon.2024.110466
extra: Part of the special issue ‘Non-equilibrium perspectives in biological conservation’, edited by Sonia Kefi, Pierre Gaüzère and Daniel Oro

citation.title: Catastrophic bifurcation in the dynamics of a threatened bird community triggered by a planetary-scale environmental perturbation

figure.label: Fold catastrophe under a slow sweep
figure.legend: Live: the fold catastrophe x′ = r + x − x³ under a slow sweep of r between −0.8 and 0.8. The state follows one branch of equilibria until it passes the fold at r = ±0.385, jumps to the other branch, and stays there when r returns, until the opposite fold: hysteresis, the signature of a catastrophic bifurcation.
